reviews.review_text: Placed my order using PayPal, and when my order hadn't arrived a week later I called Pearl Source... They had no record of my order, despite having received an order number and already being charged through PayPal.  I was asked to reverse the transaction with PayPal and place my order once more, because I couldn't cite the exact necklace and options to equal the amount I was charged.  The customer service rep I spoke with was very polite, but the company's position and process for handling their own issues was disheartening. Ultimately I did receive the necklace, but wished the "AAAA" product was a little... More, for the hassle.

Good afternoon,

I recently received the pearl earrings I ordered for my daughter. To ensure I had made a good purchase, I took them to a respected family-owned jeweler in Bethesda, Maryland, that has been in business for more than 70 years.

After examining the earrings, they shared that while the pearls were of acceptable quality, they were not exceptional. They also noted that the pearls appeared to be approximately 8mm, even though I specifically requested the larger size within the advertised range (8.5mm).

When I asked about value, they estimated that, without the branding, packaging, marketing, and online presence, the earrings would likely retail in the $350–$400 range. I even considered purchasing a pair from them and returning yours. However, the jeweler candidly advised that the time and effort involved in making the return likely would not be worth the difference. I appreciated their honesty, particularly since it meant they did not make a sale.

Needless to say, I was disappointed to hear this assessment and equally disappointed with the product I received. I find it difficult to believe that no one has raised similar concerns in the past, although I understand I have no way of knowing.

I wanted to share this feedback in the hope that you will review the quality and sizing of the pearls being sold, as the product I received did not meet the expectations created by your descriptions.

reviews.review_title: Great Customer Service - Bad Quality Control
reviews.review_text: I hate to write a negative review after experiencing such excellent customer service. The email exchange and return process were pleasant, fast, and easy — truly 10/10. However, upon opening the beautiful box, I was shocked to find a broken $450 necklace. Either a damaged necklace was knowingly packed and shipped, or the quality was so poor that it fell apart inside a secure, well‑made box. It was a disappointing surprise.
reviews.reply_text:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We sincerely appreciate your kind words about our customer service, email communication, and return process. We're truly sorry to hear that your necklace arrived damaged. We understand how disappointing that must have been, especially when opening a piece you had been looking forward to receiving. Please contact us at help@thepearlsource.com so our team can review your order and assist you as quickly as possible.

Best regards,
The Pearl Source

reviews.review_text: To clarify - My experience with the PearlSource representative was fantastic.  Great company.  My wife even cried when she opened the box because she was so happy. I deducted a star to catch the attention of the company reps so they can approach FedEx about their incredibly poor service and delivery.  My two day shipping turned into 4 days (during the business week!) and I was about to contact the local PD to report a suspected theft by one of FedEx’s employees. When I called FedEx to track the package that “no delivery was attempted” I was blatantly lied to that it would be delivered that day (day 3 of 2-day shipping) and rushed off the phone. So to conclude: PearlSource great customer service and pearl quality; Shipping was horrendous.
reviews.reply_text: Thank you for taking the time to share such thoughtful feedback. We're delighted to hear your wife loved her gift and that you had a positive experience with our team. We also appreciate you bringing your FedEx delivery experience to our attention. Your feedback is valuable, and we'll be sure to share it with our team. Thank you for taking the time to bring this to our attention.
